$comment: BOB data contract v1. ONE HOME for record shapes, states and transitions. The pane, the gates, /bob status and the export all read this file. A second copy anywhere is a defect. Validated by scripts/check_fixtures.py against fixtures/.

files.bob/approvals.json: immutable approval records; a change is a new record
files.bob/sources.json: source register with the three independent dimensions
files.docs/evidence/: raw evidence files referenced by evidence.ref

transition_rules.to_verified_requires: at least one evidence record for this requirement with kind in evidence.kinds
transition_rules.to_accepted_requires: a human source on the transition event (source = human)

approval.brief_hash: sha256 of bob/brief.json at approval time; Gate A compares it to the current file
approval.scope_hash: optional, written by /bob approve from 0.3.0: sha256 of the canonical brief (keys sorted) with each requirement's state and evidence_ids left out. Gate A accepts brief_hash OR scope_hash, so a lawful state move through the state guard does not cost a re-approval; any other change to the brief does. An approval without it keeps working on brief_hash alone

run.stale_rule: a run is stale when now - last_event_at exceeds 120 seconds while state is running or verifying; the pane shows 'stale, reconciling'
run.cost_note: cost_usd_reported is the runtime's own estimate when supplied; never summed across resumed sessions as new spend

evidence.rule: prose from a model is never evidence; a heartbeat is never evidence

source.rule: a connector or unsupported format never shows as ingested merely because a file was attached

map.$comment: R-bob-17, the one home for the map's branches (the home page docs/map.html). A requirement not listed here still gets a dot, on a branch named Other, so none can vanish. State colours: proven needs state verified or accepted AND an evidence record; built is designed, implemented or reported; todo is anything else.

gates.A_approval: deny Edit, Write and file-writing Bash when no approval has brief_hash == sha256(bob/brief.json) (or scope_hash == the brief's scope hash, see approval.scope_hash) and the active increment in scope_increment_ids; a governed repo whose every increment is done or returned (or that has none) is idle and Gate A allows writes (R-bob-16, 0.9.0), while a proposed or approved increment, an unknown increment state, a brief changed after approval and any file that does not parse still refuse; a Bash write to bob/brief.json is refused outright because the state guard sees Edit and Write only
gates.B_evidence: block the end of a turn when the active increment's requirement_ids gained no evidence record during this run

workspace.$comment: Build 3 (Cowork ADR-03). One BOB workspace folder per machine (for example ~/BOB), opened once as a saved environment. bob-workspace.json at its root registers each project, a subfolder, and names the current one. Every repo path, both gates, the preflight, /bob adopt and the pane resolve under the current project. /bob new and /bob switch are its only writers. The workspace is never a git repo; each project is its own.
workspace.template: templates/workspace/CLAUDE.md (in the plugin; copied to the workspace root once, never overwritten)
